neighbr
  api (backend, hono)
    horses: Horse
      GET /horses
      GET /horses/[id]
      POST /horses
      PATCH /horses/[id]
      DELETE /horses/[id]
      GET /horses/[id]/swipes
      GET /horses/[id]/swiped_by
      GET /horses/[id]/first_matches
      GET /horses/[id]/second_matches
    swipes: Swipe
      GET /swipes
      POST /swipes
    matches: Match
      GET /matches
      GET /matches/[id]
    swipe (endpoint)
      POST /swipe
      steps: record_swipe, match_if_mutual
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
    /horses: list of HorseCard
    /horses/[id]: HorseView
    /matches: list of MatchCard
    /horses/new: form horses.create, then /horses/[id]
    /horses/[id]/edit: form horses.update, then /horses/[id]
    /swipe: form swipe, then /matches
    HorseCard(horse: Horse)
      shows: horse.name, horse.breed, horse.age
      links to /horses/[id]
    HorseView(horse: Horse)
      shows: horse.name, horse.handle, horse.breed, horse.age, horse.bio
      opens /horses/[id]/edit
      deletes via horses.delete, then /horses
    MatchCard(match: Match)
      shows: match.first, match.second, match.matched_at
  data (3 entities)
    Horse
    Swipe
    Match
